long_biography.plain_text:
Industrialist Bob Kaiser became a champion offshore powerboat racer after watching a race on the Detroit River. Competing with throttleman Errol Lanier, he won the open-class world championship in 1986. The title came from consistent finishes across three races, including a victory in rough conditions.

His support for practical sales education produced a laboratory at Western Michigan University where students record simulated selling conversations and review their performance. Recruiters can also use the facility to assess students. A further gift in 2024 supported the laboratory's endowment, including scholarships, travel to sales competitions, teaching positions and technology upgrades.
